messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

You can now enter a **Deal name** under “Reproduce a game.” Named snapshots restore the name and progress when loaded; unnamed snapshots remain compatible with the existing format.

Pasted snapshots also load regardless of the order of their JSON properties. Invalid snapshots still leave the current game unchanged.

Validation passed: type checking, 142 unit tests, and all 79 browser tests. The repository-wide formatting check reports issues in 13 untouched files.
